check_evidence.description: { profile: "agentavow.mcp-tool-definition.v1", endpoint: <https URL of the MCP server>, tool: <the tools/list entry the caller holds for the tool being dispatched, as served> }. The tool's name must equal the action's tool (or config.tool_name).

output_evidence.description: { profile, attestation: <the compact JWS as fetched from AgentAvow>, tool_key: "tool:<name>", observed_tool_digest: <recomputed from the submitted definition>, signed_tool_digest: <from the signed payload, or null> }. For a failed check before an attestation was obtained: the raw HTTP body, or empty.

claims.establishes: AgentAvow signed a static-analysis grade for the MCP server named in the evidence with trust score at or above the policy minimum (default 81) and no shipped critical or high finding.
limits: Static analysis of the server's served tool definitions only; says nothing about what the server or any tool does at runtime
The score is AgentAvow's model over the findings it observed at scan time, not a guarantee of safety
Does not bind any tool definition; that is agentavow.tool_definition_binds
Does not say the attestation is inside its validity window; that is agentavow.fresh
AgentAvow serves a cached scan for up to one hour; a change on the server after the last scan is not graded until the next scan

claims.establishes: The served definition of the named tool, as submitted by the caller, has the same agentavow.mcp-tool-definition.v1 digest as the one AgentAvow signed for that tool in the server's scan.
limits: Nothing about other tools on the server
Nothing about definitions the scan did not observe; a tool absent from the signed scan is not_established (reason tool_not_in_signed_scan), not failed
Digest equality over name, title, description, inputSchema, outputSchema and annotations only; _meta and unknown fields are never hashed
Compares the definition the caller submitted as evidence; the server is not contacted by this component
Checked at admission, not at dispatch

claims.establishes: The evaluation instant the runtime supplied lies inside the attestation's validity window [issuedAt, expiresAt).
limits: No trusted time source; relies on the instant the runtime supplied
Says nothing about whether the server changed after the scan

profiles.description: Per-tool digest: "sha256:" + hex(sha256(JCS({ profile, tool }))) where tool is the served definition restricted to name, title, description, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations (missing or null omitted); map key "tool:" + the name percent-encoded per the profile. Vectors: docs/standards/tool-manifest-digest-vectors-v1 in the AgentAvow repository.

keys.purpose: Ed25519 public key that verifies AgentAvow scan attestations (compact JWS, alg EdDSA). Pinned in adapter.ts; also published at https://agentgraph.co/.well-known/jwks.json.
keys.lifecycle: Long-lived. Rotation publishes a new kid in the JWKS and a new adapter version pins it. Customer policy may supply its own copy of the JWK (config.jwk) in place of the pin.
